checks.title: Frozen artifacts, schemas, digests, and route inventory

checks.title: Fresh disposable workspace, identities, store, and signer sentinels
assertions: Repository-root .proof descriptor identity is rejected.
A fresh Agent and Human match config, policy, key files, and immutable principal rows.
Only existing schema-14 .proof/storage/storage.db is opened without migration.
All private directory, file, link, sidecar, and movement checks pass.

checks.title: Loopback startup, clean delivery, security headers, and shutdown
assertions: The sole process holds the descriptor-safe workspace control lock and the listener is exact IPv4 127.0.0.1.
Host, Origin, content type, peer, rate, and no-CORS boundaries are exact.
All success and error responses carry the frozen no-store security headers.
Shutdown revokes authority, quiesces writers, and zeroizes volatile buffers.

checks.title: Independent signed challenge, capability intersection, exchange, expiry, and revoke
assertions: The challenge binds nonce, instance, workspace, Human, origin, epoch, times, and requested/granted capabilities.
The browser alone displays the SAS, the terminal requires its transcription, and the enrolled Human signs exact domain-separated bytes.
One exchange winner consumes the challenge before returning one volatile 32-byte token.
Absolute, idle, replacement, revoke, and deadline-equality semantics match the contract.

checks.title: Auth-first generic failures and forwarded-header distrust
assertions: After peer, Host, target, and protected-route classification, invalid sessions receive one byte-identical 401 before Origin, body, cursor, or target lookup.
A valid session is rate-checked, then strict selectors decode and missing capabilities receive the uniform 403 before enumeration.
Forwarded headers do not influence authority, scope, or rate keys.
Failed authentication performs zero enumeration, key load, signature, provider/tool call, or governed write.

checks.title: Dedicated protected router has no legacy or general fallback
assertions: The operator router starts empty and mounts exactly fifteen routes.
General AppState, generic operations, proof/audit/domain routes, WebSockets, and E0006 routes are absent.
Wrong-method and unknown protected fallbacks authenticate before revealing route state.
Static assets are embedded and restricted to the frozen manifest.

checks.title: Bounded redacted attention projection and chronology
assertions: At least four differently situated governed runs appear with exact immutable projection sequences.
The strict kinds selector decodes after authentication and its kind-dependent capabilities are enforced before enumeration.
No path, key, credential, raw prompt, argument, output, provider, or arbitrary JSON leaks.
Latest-at-high-water projection selection matches durable chronology.

checks.title: Stable keyset pagination and fully bound cursor
assertions: Pages use sequence-descending UUID-descending keysets and a first-page high water.
Concurrent inserts and later projection versions cause no duplicate or skipped snapshot item.
The keyed cursor binds session, Human, workspace, instance, epoch, capabilities, route, filters, sort, and page size.
Tamper, expiry, restart, replacement, and cross-binding return cursor_stale after authentication.

checks.title: Run, approval, command receipt, and audit detail
assertions: Every detail route scopes to the authenticated workspace and required capability.
Run detail binds redacted authority, every bounded attempt, pending consequence, approval identity, checkpoint/fence, budgets, and Proof references.
Approval detail binds exact ReviewField input digests plus request, argument, consequence, and immutable binding digests.
Command receipts support safe uncertain-response readback and link independently verified Agent Proofs.
Audit pages verify the complete self-field-excluding digest chain and redact forbidden data.

checks.title: Exact Human approve and deny decisions never auto-resume
assertions: The session Human equals the sealed required Human and immutable enrolled key.
Request, operation, version, input, arguments, consequence, checkpoint, revision, fence, and expiry are rechecked before key load.
Decision, command, projection, audit, and receipt commit atomically and replay exactly.
Both outcomes leave the run WaitingForInput with zero provider/tool dispatch.

checks.title: Explicit resume consumes exact decisions or recoverable checkpoints
assertions: Resume requires an exact checkpoint, revisions, fence, capability, and allowed eligibility class.
Approved resume creates no dispatch until a later budget reservation and permit.
Denied resume reaches deterministic terminal failure with zero governed tool effect.
Cancelled, succeeded, ordinary failed, stale, ambiguous, undecided, and expired states reject.

checks.title: Cancellation wins before dispatch with zero effect
assertions: Cancel and begin_dispatch race in BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions.
A winning cancel seals Cancelled and blocks every later permit CAS.
Only proven pre-dispatch reservations are released.
Provider, tool, and external-effect deltas are zero; governed writes equal only the frozen atomic cancel transition bundle.

checks.title: Durable command claim, exact replay, and one race winner
assertions: Command, signer callbacks, Human decision where applicable, Agent Proof, effect, projection, audit, and terminal receipt commit all-or-none.
The workspace/Human/idempotency tuple binds the canonical complete command digest.
Exact retry returns the original byte-identical receipt; altered reuse conflicts.
No durable command-without-receipt state exists; concurrent command, revoke, expiry, cancel, and dispatch barriers have exactly one winner.

The kernel recording store exhaustively executes the frozen 21-by-9 OperatorStoreError matrix plus all four typed absence cases with exact disposition, audit, write, and termination or continuation results.
The kernel recording store iterates all 189 boundary-by-OperatorStoreError entries plus run, approval, and command-receipt OptionNone and completed-replay typed-not-found cases.

checks.title: Durable leases fence stale workers and recovery
assertions: Lease TTL is 30 seconds, renewal is 10 seconds, and equality is expired.
Reclaim increments the durable fence before exposing the checkpoint.

Claim/reclaim establish a new token under their strict expected-state CAS; every later mutable runtime call proves that raw token and binds workspace, lease, process epoch, fence, and control revision.
A stale worker can produce no run, proof, tool, budget, projection, command, receipt, or audit mutation.

checks.title: Five-dimensional aggregate budgets across concurrency and recovery
assertions: Worst-case step, token, duration, cost, and tool quantities reserve before dispatch.
Concurrent reservations serialize with no overflow and only fitting requests win.
Actual charge cannot exceed reservation and unused quantities release atomically.
Ambiguous post-permit work forfeits the full ceiling and is never auto-released.
Dispatch-token custody permits one synthetic boundary, leaves the prepared bundle unpersisted before the barrier, and atomically commits success or full-forfeit failure chronology.

checks.title: Runtime worker restart preserves the live control session
assertions: Control instance, cursor key, and active session remain unchanged.
Recovery waits for durable lease expiry and increments the fence.
Exact checkpoint, command, model/tool intent, and budget semantics are preserved.
Ambiguous dispatch is forfeited before any new dispatch.

checks.title: Control-plane restart invalidates volatile authority
assertions: Restart replaces instance, cursor key, challenges, sessions, and volatile lease tokens.
Old session headers and cursors uniformly fail before enumeration.
Durable runs, commands, receipts, projections, budgets, audit, and fences remain exact.
A new signed Human challenge is required before any protected read or action.

checks.title: Accessible UI preserves distinct Human intent and credential hygiene
assertions: Approve, deny, resume, cancel, and End Session are distinct labeled controls with stale-state confirmation.
Approval completion visibly remains waiting and never implies resume.
Session/nonce material remains closure-only and sentinel scans all browser surfaces.
Keyboard, focus, semantics, contrast, live regions, reduced motion, and zoom checks pass.

checks.title: Real E0002-15 router, store, runtime, auth, and static source composition
assertions: The runnable binary holds the sole workspace control lock and uses the non-creating no-migration schema-14 trusted opener and persisted signers.
The real HTTP constructor receives operator traits and independent auth.

checks.title: Append-only audit, signed evidence, cleanup, and independent verdict

Evidence links exact fixture, artifact, check, delta counter, and independently verified signed Proof identities without secrets.
All writers are quiescent and disposable workspaces/credentials are removed after retention.
A non-author verifier reports twenty of twenty checks, every vector, no skips, and 10000 basis points.
